real_cost.note: DO NOT TRUST. 167/874 trades (19.1%) held a strike that drifted outside the lake's ATM-relative +-10 window; base._px() then returns intrinsic value, so an OTM short is 'bought back' for 0. Those trades win 88.0% (avg +Rs24,211) vs 48.2% (avg +Rs1,423) for clean ones and carry 80.1% of the reported Rs50.5L net. Clean-only net is Rs10.1L, and that subset is itself biased (it is the low-movement days). Wings cannot be made real either: they sit at offset 11, outside the lake. Needs a wider lake before any re-run.
